title: Docs list every command that takes --render
findings_note: s359 relay 2026-10-18: the docs/commands.md "Every command that changes state" list omits config, template, catalog, id-prefix, issues-pull, note-verify and relay-roles; docs/agents.md's "every mutating command takes --render ... except land" does not account for relay-run, feedback or init; s366 relay: docs/agents.md:370 says "backticked repo paths" for --disjoint where configuration.md says project paths
boundary: **Not in this slice:** adding `--render` to any command.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s359 caught the lists up with v1.14's commands but found more gaps: several commands that write tracked state and take `--render` are not listed, and the agents.md rule has unlisted exceptions. A test that derives the list from the parser would stop the drift.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/commands.md`, `docs/agents.md` (also the --disjoint sentence near 370: "project paths", as docs/configuration.md says).
- `tests/test_docs.py` (or the existing docs test module): a test that every parser with `--render` is named in the list, and every listed command has it.
- `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test; watch it go red.
2. Complete the lists; name the exceptions in agents.md.
3. CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
